checks: Final candidate passed the embedded PostgreSQL suite and synthetic sender suite described in initial_checks.
Unicode boundary check from repair-001 remains applicable to unchanged validation sources.
Core and Mobile syntax transpilation, cached strict Mobile typecheck, OpenAPI local references, Compose config and integration harness syntax passed.

Full clean dependency installation, Core build, Redocly lint/bundle, Expo device runtime and Docker acceptance are blocked or unverified. Docker Engine responds with named-pipe permission denied. npm registry access and offline cache could not supply all locked dependencies.

security_results.evidence: PGlite duplicate creation and receipts passed. Parallel PostgreSQL sessions and real HTTPS responses remain unverified.
Unicode repair verified, synthetic handler mapping and local YAML references passed. Gateway requests and Redocly remain unverified.
Salted scrypt, digest, encrypted outbox and worker role tested. Runtime log sampling remains unavailable.
Serialized activation and replay passed. Concurrent PostgreSQL verification and a verification-specific rollback case remain unobserved.
Embedded PostgreSQL under a controlled clock passed checks immediately before, on and after expiry and on resend. Equivalent Gateway HTTP remains unverified.
Serialized three-of-four quota with correct reentry time passed. Full account-state matrix on concurrent PostgreSQL sessions remains unobserved.
Identity correctly rejects an unverified account and marks a verified account eligible. UC02 session issuance and protected access remain pending.
Synthetic sender covered retries, expiry, lease recovery, rollback and unchanged receipt. Real Mailpit, process restart and duplicate delivery remain unobserved.
Mailbox action and typing corrections reviewed; isolated strict Mobile check passed. Expo device flow and actual email deep link remain unobserved.

apps/core/src/modules/identity/email-jobs.ts clears expired encrypted payloads on Worker processing. A stopped Worker can leave ciphertext beyond token expiry until it runs again. The approved maximum retention would require an independent expiry mechanism or an approved adjustment to the bound. Gateway TLS, real link and runtime log samples also remain unverified.

next_action: Resume live acceptance once this session can connect to Docker Engine and restore the locked dependencies. Resolve the approved encrypted-payload retention deadline during downtime, then verify Mobile linking and the UC02 handoff when their runtime prerequisites are available.
